audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the seven chart rows contradict the page's own why-text. The chart reads Skill/Vladimir/Vladimir/Skill/Skill/Vladimir/Vladimir while whys[0..3] all say the stage is Kennen's, whys[4] and whys[5] say even, and whys[6] says Vladimir.
audit.why: The packet chart is Kennen/Kennen/Kennen/Kennen/Skill/Skill/Vladimir — identical to what the prose already says. The chart rows were the only part out of step, and a ranged bully with a 950-range Q does not lose Levels 2-3 to a 600-range melee drain.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3 flipped to Kennen and row 5 to Skill, all ten edits proposed as one matched full/content group.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere on the page — the packet flags zero sequencing cues — and Level 6 was written as a generic Hemoplague line.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom and Hemoplague are both flat 120s, which makes level 6 a straight trade of ultimates rather than a spike for either player. That symmetry is the whole reason the stage is even.
audit.corrected: Both 120s numbers stated in spikes[1].text with the bait-then-commit order; Q 7-4s, W 13-6s and E 10s written into the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page makes Lightning Rush the thing to track ('His escape') on nine strings. The ability that actually kills you is Mark of the Storm — three marks stun — and the page never says how many marks or that Electrical Surge re-marks an already-marked target.
audit.why: Riot's text: the passive stuns enemies hit 3 times with his abilities; W 'adds another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked'; E applies a mark while passing through units. Lightning Rush matters as the third mark, not as an escape. Q is 950 range against Transfusion's 600, which is why the early stages are his.
audit.corrected: Mark-counting made the tracked thing in tldr, dosFull[0].d, spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0]; the range mismatch stated explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization named Mercury's Treads without a reason, and nothing addressed his on-hit damage.
audit.why: Electrical Surge applies on-hit and scales with attack speed — Lightning Rush grants attack speed on exit — so armour reads the trade wrong; tenacity against the three-mark stun is the real reason for the boots.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now ties Mercury's Treads to the stun rather than to armour.

edits.before: AP brawl — build MR, Q-poke war, pool his combo. Vladimir wins the Lightning Rush cooldown windows.
edits.after: AP brawl — build MR and count his marks: three Marks of the Storm stun you, and that is his whole plan.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. Poke when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kennen Lightning Rush: 10s at rank 1 — his escape and his third mark. - Thundering Shuriken: 7s, dropping to 4s. - Electrical Surge: 13s to 6s, and it re-marks. - Slicing Maelstrom: 120s, same as yours.

edits.before: His escape. Poke when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 10s at rank 1, and it lands his third mark — count marks, not just cooldowns.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Riftmaker  (drain scaling), then Zhonya's Hourglass; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Riftmaker, then Zhonya's Hourglass; boots Mercury's Treads for the stun, not armour.

edits.before: Kennen pokes free with Thundering Shuriken (Q) and Electrical Surge (W), stacking your passive toward a Lightning Rush (E) stun; play behind minions because his Q outranges your Transfusion and he zones you off CS.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken (Q) is 950 range against your 600 Transfusion, and Electrical Surge (W) re-marks a marked target — three Marks of the Storm stun you, so break the chain by walking out after the second.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom (R) is a huge teamfight tool but 1v1 you can pool the stun-storm — level 6 starts closing the gap as your Hemoplague and sustain answer his ranged chip.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is 120s, the same as Hemoplague, and Sanguine Pool's 2 seconds of untargetability sits out the storm — bait his R out, then commit yours.

edits.before: Poke free with Q/W and stack passive toward a Lightning Rush stun
edits.after: Stack three Marks of the Storm with Q, W and E for the stun

notes: The mirror summary I was given lists a chart (row 3 Vladimir, rows 4 and 5 Kennen) that disagrees with the packet chart on three rows, while its own notes say it was set to match the packet. I went with the packet chart, because it also matches this page's seven why-rows word for word. If the mirror really did ship row 3 as Vladimir, mirror-fix will collide there — worth a look before applying. Whether Sanguine Pool's untargetability clears already-applied Marks of the Storm or only avoids the next one is not in the kit data, so I wrote only that it sits out the storm damage.
